title: Armstrong Number Program
statement:
A positive integer with `d` decimal digits is an **Armstrong number** (also called a narcissistic number) if it equals the sum of its digits, each raised to the power `d`.

For example, a 3-digit number `abc` is an Armstrong number when `a^3 + b^3 + c^3` equals the number itself.

Given `n`, print `YES` if it is an Armstrong number and `NO` otherwise. Every one-digit number is an Armstrong number.
outputFormat: Print `YES` if `n` is an Armstrong number, otherwise print `NO`.
hints: First find how many digits n has, since that is the exponent.
Extract digits with n % 10 and n // 10, adding digit ** d to a running total.
Compare the total with the original n, not with the value you destroyed while extracting digits.
